idCompatibilityNote: Several stable feature ids retain the historical realpass prefix to avoid unnecessary identifier churn. The prefix is internal compatibility residue, not current product identity.
purpose: Consolidation ledger for behavior once explored through source/reference mods and for project-original Biology feature families. Source/reference mods are inspiration/history only; no executing gameplay or presentation behavior from them is part of the Biology target. Biology starts from vanilla Cyberpunk identities and substitutes project-original mechanics only where the authored physical model requires it.
